description: USB 2.0 Type-C receptacle for full-speed devices (HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12), 5.1k pulldowns on CC1/CC2 for 5V sink, 3.6V zener clamps on D+/D-. No 1.5k data pull-up: full-speed devices with an internal pull-up (CH340, RP2040, STM32) connect directly. Socket and ESD are LCSC Extended (no Basic alternative exists in the JLC catalogue); the CC resistors are Basic. Layout included. Superseded by USB-C_Socket_FullSpeed_SRV05, which uses an SRV05-4 array instead of the zeners (roughly 300x lower line capacitance, nanosecond clamping, also protects CC1/CC2); kept as the simpler variant when a zener is acceptable.
keywords: usb usb-c type-c connector full-speed sink cc-resistor esd
